Metadata.title: Terecode - The universal UI compiler
Metadata.description: Write your UI components once in a clean, declarative language. Terecode compiles them to idiomatic React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular, and more - real source code, not a runtime.
Metadata.ogDescription: One component language. Ten frameworks. Terecode compiles .trc components to idiomatic, readable code for every target.

Why.title: The same UI, everywhere - without the copy-paste.
Why.lead: Teams shipping to web and mobile maintain the same components many times over. Terecode collapses that into a single, declarative source.
Why.card1Body: Stop rebuilding the same button, form, and card in every framework. Author components, design tokens, skins, and themes once.
Why.card2Body: Terecode emits idiomatic source for each target - hooks and clsx for React, runes for Svelte, signals for Solid. Code you can read, diff, and own.
Why.card3Body: There's nothing to ship to your users. The output is plain framework code with zero Terecode dependency at runtime.

Targets.title: One language. Every framework you actually use.
Targets.lead: Each emitter generates code that looks like a senior engineer wrote it by hand for that platform - following its conventions, not a lowest common denominator.

CodeTour.title: The same component, idiomatic on every side.
CodeTour.lead: One Counter.trc, two outputs. React gets hooks; Svelte 5 gets runes and native events. Nothing generic - each reads like hand-written code.

Features.title: Everything around the language, included.
Features.lead: Terecode isn't just a compiler - it's the full workflow: authoring, styling, tooling, and design integration.
Features.f1Body: React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular, React Native, Web Components, Astro, Flutter, and Kotlin Compose - all from one IR.
Features.f2Body: Design tokens, component skins, and themes are first-class. Style once and resolve to CSS variables, StyleSheet, or platform styles.
Features.f3Body: Already have React or Vue components? Bring them back into Terecode - round-trips to .trc with structure preserved.
Features.f4Body: Completion, hover, go-to-definition, and diagnostics for .trc files, with context-aware suggestions inside every block.
Features.f5Body: An idempotent formatter for every file type, plus a Storybook addon that generates stories and controls from your components.
Features.f6Body: Keep design and code in step - sync tokens and components between Terecode and your Figma libraries.
